_comment: Lives at .7k/forms.json. Optional composer hints, per record; every key is an override and an absent file changes nothing. See ../docs/spec/20-ir.md section 6.3. This copy is an illustration of the format, kept here because a real .7k/forms.json is per-developer and gitignored - unlike views.json, which is shared and so lives at .7k/views.json for real.
